proposal_text: Approve Discharge of Board and Senior Management

Approve Dividends of CHF 0.165 per Share from Capital Contribution Reserves; Dividends of CHF 0.15 per Share for Fiscal Year 2023 and Special Dividend of CHF 0.60 per Share in Connection with the Sale of Climate Division
Reelect Alexander von Witzleben as Director, Board Chair, and Member of the Nomination and Compensation Committee
Reelect Peter Barandun as Director and Member of the Nomination and Compensation Committee
Reelect Markus Oppliger as Director and Member of the Nomination and Compensation Committee
Designate Roland Keller as Independent Proxy
Approve CHF 278 Million Reduction in Share Capital via Reduction of Nominal Value and Repayment of CHF 4.00 per Share
Approve Creation of Capital Band with or without Exclusion of Preemptive Rights
Approve Remuneration of Directors in the Amount of CHF 2.4 Million
Approve Remuneration of Executive Committee in the Amount of CHF 2.2 Million
Accept Financial Statements and Statutory Reports for Fiscal Year 2024
Approve Allocation of Income and Dividends of EUR 1.97 per Ordinary Share and EUR 2.03 per Preferred Share
Approve Discharge of Personally Liable Partner for Fiscal Year 2024
Approve Discharge of Supervisory Board for Fiscal Year 2024
Ratify KPMG AG as Auditors for Fiscal Year 2025 and as Auditor for Sustainability Reporting for Fiscal Year 2025
Elect Peter Bartels to the Supervisory Board
Amend Articles Re: General Meeting Chair
Ratify Deloitte & Touche LLP as Auditors
Advisory Vote to Ratify Named Executive Officers' Compensation
Approve Allocation of Income, with a Final Dividend of JPY 53
Appoint Alternate Statutory Auditor Nozaki, Akira
Approve Donation of Treasury Shares to Social Intrapreneur Development Foundation
